title: ZTO Express Reports Q3 2026 Revenue Up 21.0% Year Over Year
summary: ZTO Express reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of RMB14,361.6 million, up 21.0%, with net income of RMB2,573.4 million and parcel volume up 7.0%.
body_markdown:
Gross margin was 24.6%, compared with 24.9% a year earlier. Other costs rose 59.1% to RMB4,570.4 million, mainly due to higher pickup and dispatching costs paid to network partners for handling e-commerce return parcels, the release said. Chief Financial Officer Huiping Yan said adjusted net income grew 20.7% year over year "taking into consideration of RMB376 million tax refund received in the same quarter last year," and that the company is "maintaining our parcel-volume growth guidance for the year."


**What to watch next:** Mr. Xing Liu's resignation as a non-executive director of ZTO takes effect on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, the same day Mr. Wei Zhu, an independent non-executive director, joins the board's audit committee and compensation committee.
